notes.title: v0.7.0.0 - New tutorial, plus tons of features
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Metaverse version 0.7.0.0![/h1]
We're so excited to release this to you.  This is our biggest update ever.  In addition to the new tutorial and start of story mode, we've added tons of new features and polish.  Thanks for all your support and feedback along the way!

[h1]A note for users with existing game saves:[/h1]
The updated Metaverse planet looks quite a bit different from the one you've got now.  But we worked hard to make sure not to break your current planet or B.I.T.s.  If you want to, you can remain on your current planet as is and keep building your base.  The main difference for you will be that you will need to deploy your new Quantum Core when you load the game.  But if you really want the full experience, we recommend starting fresh by clicking the New Simulation button in the main menu.  This will erase your current game save and let you start fresh with the new tutorial and planet.  If you have B.I.T. schematics in the Simulation Deck, you should publish them to Workshop before you erase your game save, so that you can download them again after you click New Simulation.

Also, be sure to check out the new free Construction Kit, which has support for VR.  You can find out more about it here: [url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/422630[/url]

[h1]And without further ado, here's what's new:[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Brand new tutorial and start of story mode.
  [*]New GFR-AR7 Assault Rifle.
  [*]New gear select menu.
  [*]Updated all B.I.T. materials.
  [*]Added new Structural B.I.T. models.
  [*]The LAIR has been removed from the game, in favor of a new Quantum Core.
  [*]Added compass and lat/lon to the HUD.
  [*]Added ability to melee.
  [*]Added Take All button to backpack.
  [*]Added oxygen and stamina.
  [*]Health, stamina, oxygen, and energy automatically fill up when in range of a Bio Generator or the Quantum Core.
  [*]Max player energy is now 3x what it was before.
  [*]Added Situation station basics.  More to come soon.
  [*]Added Bio Generator to Technical B.I.T. category.  Build these to re-generate barren terrain and to replenish your vitals.
  [*]Weapons now use ammunition instead of energy.
  [*]Added Lethal and Non-Lethal ammunition to Essential B.I.T. category.
  [*]New music for tutorial.
  [*]Added ability to double-click to install gear.
  [*]Added ability to hold Shift to queue up 10 item at a time in the Fabricator.
  [*]New block place and take holograms.
  [*]Much improved UI for the Simulation station.
  [*]Added ability to paint B.I.T.s in the Simulation station.
  [*]New sounds for pick and place in the Simulation station.
  [*]Added ability to move up and down in the Simulation station.
  [*]Massive improvement in B.I.T. place/edit performance when dealing with lots of B.I.T.s.
  [*]New ship in intro video.
  [*]Quantum Beacons now teleport you to the last used Quantum Beacon.
  [*]Multiplayer UI is now in the main menu.
  [*]Added UI sounds.
  [*]Updated description text for all periodic table elements.
  [*]Less lag when loading saved B.I.T. schematics.
  [*]Fixed periodic table row labeled 51-71 instead of 57-71.  Also fixed a couple of periodic table elements being wrong.
  [*]Fixed Omni UI slow to load.
  [*]Fixed the loud bleep noise at the start of the game.
  [*]Fixed being able to fabricate B.I.T.s without selecting a pattern.
  [*]Fixed clicking the Fabricate button really fast could sometimes get you more B.I.T.s than you had resources for.
  [*]Fixed B.I.T. placement being jittery sometimes.
  [*]Disable auto-adjacent B.I.T. placement when switching B.I.T. types.  Same when using Undo.
  [*]Fixed terrain flickering black under certain lighting conditions.
  [*]Fixed terrain looking white in the distance at night.
  [*]Fixed B.I.T. Boxes not containing the full amounts of some items when you drop them when you die.
  [*]Fixed a bug where gear could become broken if removed from a gear slot.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.5.6 - Fix for simulation deck undo
notes.content:
0.3.5.5 had a bug that could cause B.I.T.S. to become duplicated many times when using the new undo feature.  The problem is fixed now in 0.3.5.6.  Sorry about that!

One other thing: if undo isn't working for you, go to the input configuration screen and click the button at the bottom to reset to default.  That'll force the new Undo key mapping to load.

And as a recap, here's what was new in 0.3.5.5:


This week we've got something (hopefully) very useful: undo in the simulation deck.  Just hit ctrl+z.  You've got 100 levels of undo now, so no more worrying about messing up your patterns!

Here are a few other things we changed:

[list]
  [*]Simulation tab is now the default screen shown when pulling up the Omni UI on the simulation deck.
  [*]Fixed a bug where publishing to Workshop sometimes didn't publish the latest changes.
  [*]When loading a pattern, fixed the pattern's position sometimes being shifted to somewhere else (sometimes too far off in the distance to even see it).  There was no way to automatically fix patterns that had gotten shifted like this.  So if you want your old patterns to be positioned where you can see them when you load them, the easiest thing to do is to load your pattern, then press the button to clear it (you'll still be able to place it), then place the pattern, then save it out.  You may especially want to do this and then re-publish your items if you've published anything to Workshop, so that users who download your pattern will see it right away when they load it.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.5.3 - Workshop support for simulation deck
notes.content:
[h1]We've got Workshop support for you in the simulation deck now.[/h1]
If you've already used the simulation deck, it should be pretty straightforward.  Here a few tips:

You'll notice there's a new "Browse Workshop" button on the Simulation screen in the Omni UI (tab menu) on the simulation deck.  While browsing, if you see something you like, just click the Subscribe button and it'll be downloaded into the game.  The same applies even if you're just browsing in a web browser outside of the game: anything you subscribe to will be downloaded for you in the game.

When you've created something you would like to share, click the new Publish Current Pattern button.  You'll get a progress bar, and then it'll open up the Workshop page for your new item so you can edit its attributes if you want.

One other thing that's fixed here is a potential crash while in the simulation deck.  Special thanks to dasrobse for reporting the bug!



There is one known issue with the simulation deck in the current build: if you exit the game while on the simulation deck, the next time you come back, the Omni UI might be sideways.  If this happens to you, open the Omni UI, then move backwards a little bit so you can see more of it.  Maneuver your cursor so that you can click the Simulation screen button (up/down will move it left/right, and vice versa).  Once on the Simulation screen, click the Exit Simulation button, which will take you to the main level.  Exit the game, then open it back up and you'll be good to go.  Alternatively, you could hold Left Alt + Right Shift, and type IVEFALLENANDICANTGETUP. If done correctly, it will appear to freeze the game.  Just hit the Esc key to get to the main menu and exit the game.  Re-launch the game and you'll be good to go.

notes.title: v0.3.5.2 - Simulation deck
notes.content:
The main highlight this week is the new simulation deck, accessible via the LAIR elevator.

Here's how to use the new simulation deck:

Head to the elevator and press the option to go to the Simulation Level.  Once there, the simulation deck will automatically activate and you'll see a big empty space you can build in.

Hit Tab to bring up the Omni UI and select the new button at the top called Simulation.  It looks very similar to the Fabrication screen, but on this screen, you can choose any schematic and pattern you want and build without having to have the required resources and without any wait time.  Click the Simulate button to start building with the block you selected.

When you've built something you like, you can click the Save Current Pattern button on the Simulation screen in the Omni UI.  After you save it, you can find it by clicking on the Technical tab, then click the mass storage device, which is the one in the shape of a cube.  You'll see your saved pattern on the right side of the screen.  If you select it, you can click the Simulate button just as you would with a regular block.  In this way you can make your own custom patterns to be used multiple times in your fabrications.

After you're done in the simulation deck, hit the Exit Simulation button at the bottom of the Simulation screen in the Omni UI.

Now that you've saved a pattern, you can fabricate it just like you would any other block for placement out in the world.  When you've got enough resources for everything in your pattern, just head to the Fabrication screen in the Omni UI and click on the Technical tab.  Select the mass storage device, then select your pattern, and click the Fabricate button.

We really hope you enjoy this!  Workshop support is coming up right behind this update, so go ahead and get building so you'll be ready to share your creations.  We're excited to see what you come up with!

As always, if you have any questions, need clarification, or just want to chat, we hang out on the forums.  Looking forward to hearing from you all.


Here's the full list of what's new this week:

[list]
  [*]Simulation deck!
  [*]Tweaked arch block.
  [*]Increased Omni UI transition speed.
  [*]Removed giant slab and giant arch panel, since they can be created in the simulation deck now.
  [*]Tweaked some materials and graphics.
  [*]Fixed drones being able to see you through walls.
  [*]Fixed shooting terrain could sometimes cause an error that would stop the terrain from updating properly after that.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.0.9 - Easier BIT placement, performance improvements, and more
notes.content:
[h1]Here's what's new this week:[/h1]

[list]
  [*]BIT placement is much easier now.  Previously it felt like positioning BITs was a matter of obeying the placement system's constraints.  Now it should feel much more like you're in total control.  Still some work to be done, but this update is a big improvement.
  [*]After placing a BIT, placement for the next BIT defaults to a position adjacent to the one you just placed. So for example, now you can build a tower up high without necessarily having to get up high yourself. If you want to place the next BIT anywhere besides adjacent to the last BIT, just move the placement cursor away from the last BIT and it'll switch back to letting you place it anywhere. This is a little difficult to describe here in text, but it should make sense in game.
  [*]LAIR elevator no longer automatically goes to the main level!
  [*]Massively improved performance if you have lots and lots of BITs on screen (e.g. a castle or village).
  [*]New quantum distortion effect when harvesting terrain and BITs.
  [*]Bullets now destroy terrain (look out -- a temporary dirt structure won't hold up long against drones).
  [*]"Newly discovered element" modal now only covers the periodic table of the elements.
  [*]Fixed a potential error when destroying BITs.
  [*]Fixed explosions and camera shake not working in the intro.
[/list]

notes.title: Roadmap to Beta
notes.content:
[u]We've been quiet for a bit, and we wanted to give everyone an update as to why, and what to expect in the coming months.[/u]

We’ve been working on the final major reboot of the game as we march toward a Beta. This final major refactoring includes everything we've learned from our previous experiments and the feedback we've received thus far.

[b]Below you’ll find a list of the upcoming updates that will contain this work, in the order of their planned release:[/b]

[h1]Construction Reboot/Update[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Completely refactored the B.I.T.s system based on all the feedback we’ve received. (Of note, you'll no longer research patterns over time. Instead, they'll be discovered in the world.)
   [*]There are many different types of B.I.T.s now. (More on that soon.)
   [*]Dynamic B.I.T. Destruction
   [*]Harvesting Gauntlet Improvements
   [*]New and improved HUD based on feedback
   [*]New construction workflow
   [*]All new omni-station UI that consolidates the old physical workstations from the lair. (It is accessible at any time from anywhere in the world.)
   [*]Here's a glimpse at some of the sections of the new Omni-Station UI:
[/list]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/325430/extras/omniStation_computation.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/325430/extras/omniStation_extraction.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/325430/extras/omniStation_fabrication.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/325430/extras/omniStation_integration.jpg[/img]


[h1]Exploration Reboot/Update[/h1]
[list]
   [*]New Situation Station UI  (part of OmniStation)
   [*]New fluid movement engine (Climb, leap, run on walls)
   [*]Wildlife
   [*]Vegetation overhaul and optimization 
   [*]Proper biomes
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/325430/extras/biomes.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tutorial reboot[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Based on all the feedback we’ve received on the current one, plus an intro to the all new story mode.
[/list]

[h1]Story/ Combat Update[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Procedural Enemy Invasion
   [*]Lots of weapons
   [*]Variety of Enemies
   [*]Deep combat system
   [*]Lots of story
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer Update[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Tons of improvements and refinements
   [*]Simulation deck
   [*]Workshop
   [*]Custom avatar
   [*]Coop
   [*]Planetary Wars
[/list]

And lots more in-between.

We're excited to ship the construction update soon. The necessary changes were the most involved and disruptive to having a stable build. Once it's out though, we'll be able to transition back to a much more frequent update schedule, which is something we've really missed during this rewrite!

As always, please let us know what you think, positive or negative! Metaverse wouldn't be shaping up to become the experience that it is if it weren't for our community.

- Thanks! - Creo & Vox

notes.title: What to do if Metaverse crashes
notes.content:
We do our best to keep Metaverse stable and working well, but it is in a constant state of development, and if it does crash on your computer, here's what you can do:

[list]
  [*]Make sure your graphics card drivers are up to date.  This is the most common cause for a crash, so it's important to make sure everything's updated.  [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=6416-EYDH-0477]Click here for instructions[/url].
  [*]Restart your computer.  Seems simple, but if memory is constrained this will clear it up.
  [*]Try the troubleshooting steps listed [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=7169-TIAV-5361]here[/url].
  [*]Email us at support@jointhemetaverse.com and be sure to include the following:
[olist]
  [*]As many details as you can about the crash (how often it happens, when it happens, etc).
  [*]Your dxdiag report.  You can get this in Windows by clicking on the Start menu, then clicking on Run.  Type dxdiag and click OK.  Click the Save All Information button and in the Save As dialog, make sure it's set to save as a .txt file.
  [*]Right-click on Metaverse in Steam and click on Properties.  Select the Local Files tab, then click the Browse Local Files button.  On Windows, you should see a Metaverse_Data folder.  If there are any other folders next to that one (don't include the Cubic_Data folder if it's there), zip them up and email them to us.  Also check inside the Metaverse_Data folder for output_log.txt and email that to us as well.
[/olist]
[/list]

We welcome all feedback and are working hard to make Metaverse the best it can be.  Please don't hesitate to tell us how we're doing in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/325430/discussions/]forums[/url].  It's also possible that other players may have solutions to the same problem, so posting in the forums is another great way to get support.

notes.title: What to do if Metaverse crashes
notes.content:
We do our best to keep Metaverse stable and working well, but it is in a constant state of development, and if it does crash on your computer, here's what you can do:

[list]
  [*]Make sure your graphics card drivers are up to date.  This is the most common cause for a crash, so it's important to make sure everything's updated.  [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=6416-EYDH-0477]Click here for instructions[/url].
  [*]Restart your computer.  Seems simple, but if memory is constrained this will clear it up.
  [*]Try the troubleshooting steps listed [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=7169-TIAV-5361]here[/url].
  [*]Email us at support@jointhemetaverse.com and be sure to include the following:
[olist]
  [*]As many details as you can about the crash (how often it happens, when it happens, etc).
  [*]Your dxdiag report.  You can get this in Windows by clicking on the Start menu, then clicking on Run.  Type dxdiag and click OK.  Click the Save All Information button and in the Save As dialog, make sure it's set to save as a .txt file.
  [*]Right-click on Metaverse in Steam and click on Properties.  Select the Local Files tab, then click the Browse Local Files button.  On Windows, you should see a Metaverse_Data folder.  If there are any other folders next to that one (don't include the Cubic_Data folder if it's there), zip them up and email them to us.  Also check inside the Metaverse_Data folder for output_log.txt and email that to us as well.
[/olist]
[/list]

We welcome all feedback and are working hard to make Metaverse the best it can be.  Please don't hesitate to tell us how we're doing in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/325430/discussions/]forums[/url].  It's also possible that other players may have solutions to the same problem, so posting in the forums is another great way to get support.

notes.title: Version 0.1.0.0 is here, and it's a big one!
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
  [*]New LAIR stations to research and fabricate B.I.T.s, which are pre-built blocks that can be used to build structures out in the world.
  [*]Caves!!
  [*]Overall beautification.  Cubic’s looking sharp!
  [*]Cubic is now 64 bit, which translates to increased performance.
  [*]Improved shadowing, and made underground areas actually dark.
  [*]Added a flashlight (press V to toggle)
  [*]Added clouds.
  [*]Increased draw distance.
  [*]Grass and trees are now always shown as far as the eye can see wherever the terrain has been drawn.
  [*]Increased walk/run speed.
  [*]Added sounds for elevator buttons.
  [*]Tons of little tweaks and improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Jazz hands came back, so we swatted them away again.
  [*]Sun flare no longer visible before eyelids open during intro.
[/list]

[h1][i]Warning[/i][/h1]
  [*][i]This update will clear your backpack and lair inventory.  When you start playing with it though, you’ll see that it was totally worth it![/i]

notes.title: The Information Exchange Update (0.0.3.3)
notes.content:
[h1][b]No tricks, just a treat! [/b][/h1]
Today we're releasing our third major update, and with it,  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=325430] Steam Workshop [/url]  support, through the new Information Exchange feature! 

Even in this initial version, we made sure that workshop support is completely integrated into the Cubic Metaware, which means that you can browse and download other player's shared fabrication schematics entirely from within Cubic. 

Just check out the new browse tab on your Fabrication Station. Don't worry though, if it's your thing, you can still use the standard steam workshop web experience to browse and rate your fellow contributor's schematics. 

This is just a first step, among many, that we will be taking to more deeply connect our community to each other and to us. Still, we are really excited for the potential momentum around collaborative construction and iteration of fabrications within just this first version of the feature. 

 
[h1][b]To get things kicked off, we wanted to have a fun little pumpkin carving contest![/b][/h1]
We've gone ahead and uploaded a generic pumpkin schematic that you can download in-game and customize however you like. Three winners will be picked, based on a combination of votes from the community and an interpreted amount of originality (since derivation is likely to occur). [i]Deadline for submissions is November 1st, 10am PST.[/i]

[b] - 1st Place[/b] - Will receive an Investors key to upgrade their account as well as a Cubic 4-pack to share with their friends. 

[b] - 2nd Place[/b] - Will receive an Investors key and another copy of Cubic to share. 

[b] - 3rd Place[/b] - Will receive an Investors key and a well intentioned but still imagined ethereal high-five. 
 
Good luck, and have fun to all who take a "stab" at the contest! 


[h1][b]One to many:[/b][/h1]
Finally, since this is the very first step for Cubic in to a community of interconnectedness, let's focus on being a community known for being excellent to one another, from the very beginning through to the hopefully very distant end! 

As always please report any bugs or feature requests that pop up and we'll get them added to the development list.


[h1][b]------------ FULL CHANGE LOG ------------[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Publish and download Fabricator schematics via the new Information Exchange.
[/list]
[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Made Fabricator text much more readable.
[*]Made Fabricator camera save its position when a schematic is saved.
[*]Now auto-synthesizing colors when fabricating if enough materials are in storage.
[/list]
[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved save game files on Mac to a much safer location.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.3.1 Available Now!
notes.content:
Our last update, version 0.0.3.0 introduced some really cool new features in the Fabricator.  Unfortunately, only a few people got to enjoy them because in our excitement to bring you those new features, we neglected to fully regression test some parts of the game, which left some things broken for many people.  We're truly sorry for that, and will do our very best to make sure that doesn't happen again. And as always, if you do experience bugs, or if you have feedback (good or bad), we encourage you to comment in the forums or email us at support@cubicdevice.com.  So without further ado, here's what's new:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed Fabricator portion of tutorial being completely broken and impassable.
[*]Fixed LAIR floor turning to quicksand while player is in Fabricator.
[*]Fixed door placement part of tutorial being broken.
[*]Fixed fabrications not made out of plastic could not be placed in world.
[*]Fixed being unable to fabricate an object that contains plain uncolored plastic.
[*]Fixed player view getting stuck in the fully zoomed in mode during teleport if they were in the LAIR before the delivery orb sequence starts.
[*]Fixed crash bug on Mac that prevented us from releasing 0.0.3.0 on Mac.[/list]

And of course, all the awesome new features we added in 0.0.3.0:

[url=http://www.cubicdevice.com/images/update_graphics/0.0.3.0.png][img]http://www.cubicdevice.com/images/update_graphics/0.0.3.0.png[/img][/url]

[b]FABRICATION STATION UPGRADE[/b]
Not only has the fabricator resources view been completely rewritten,
it also has a new Combinator module for the synthesis of synthetic
building materials. Don't know if you should be excited about that
or not? The best way to describe the new Combinator module is to
think of crafting, but on a molecular level.
 
[b]1300Kg OF PRE-SYNTHESIZED PLASTIC, DELIVERED TO YOUR DOOR[/b]
And just so you can start building right away, a delivery orb has 
been dispatched with a collection of raw plastic polymers.
 
[b]FOUR PIGMENTS, 10,000,000 POSSIBILITIES[/b]
If you're thinking, "playing with grey plastic doesn't sound very fun," 
we agree. That's why we've also included some pre-processed pigments
for you to use with the raw plastic polymer in the new Colorizer module
of the Fabricator.
 
[b]FOUR NEW FORMULAS FOR THE COMBINATOR[/b]
To make sure the plastic party never has to end,
 we are including the formula for a highly durable, 
heat resistant polymer plastic. Plus the formulas 
for the four base pigments mentioned earlier.
 
[b]POWERED UP[/b]
Two power cells just aren't enough these days.  And since 
they are Quantum Technology, they aren't fabricatable yet. 
So we threw in one of these as well, just in case.  That, or 
you'll definitely want one for what's coming in the next update... 
 
[b]FULL CHANGE-LOG:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Fabrication Station holographic UI
[*]New Plastic Polymer formula
[*]New base Pigment formulas
[*]New Colorizer module
[*]New Combinator Module
[*]New Synthetics Module
    [*]Added Corban’s voice during Fabricator portion of tutorial instead of just using subtitles.
    [*]Fixed Corban looking in the wrong direction during tutorial at the Fabrication Station.
    [*]Fixed loader’s clicking/beeping sound potentially persisting past loader.
    [*]Fixed typo (Presss E) when touching mission cube for the first time.
    [*]Fixed lair colors not fully red in Sandbox mode.
    [*]Fixed jumping from happening during tutorial before the Metavar has even stood up.
     [*]Fixed gravity in LAIR to match gravity of outside world.
    [*]Fixed infinite jump in LAIR.
    [*]Fixed flickering hands during tutorial (sorry, no more Jazz hands)
    [*]Made camera lock in place when viewing holographic UI panels (to prevent UI shimmering)
    [*]Fixed white screen of death.
[*]Distribution of refined elements when processing from raw source elements is now based on real world element abundance.
   [*]Fixed camera rotation getting messed up if you’re not looking straight ahead when Corban docks for the very first time.
   [*]Fixed Corban not docking when Snapback is activated, which meant he was having to travel by himself in realtime back to the LAIR.
